# On and off by default — the `pandas` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#pandas).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** never — installing the pack is the opt-in.
- **Rules:** 12 — 0 on, 0 on with `preview = true`, 12 off in an opt-in preset, 0 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `pandas/recommended` | no — opt in | 12 | 12 warn | the 12 pandas-vet, through Ruff's `PD` rules (Ruff 0.16.9) that Ruff calls stable, reimplemented (W-139) |
